title: Up. The flying house.
lines: Carl is an old man.
He has a square head, big glasses and a walking stick with four tennis balls on the bottom.
Carl lives in a small, colourful house.
He used to live there with his wife Ellie.
Ellie and Carl had a dream together.
One day they wanted to go to Paradise Falls, in South America.
A beautiful waterfall, on top of a high mountain, far away in the jungle.
But they never got there.
Life was always too busy.
And now Ellie isn't here anymore.
Carl is alone.
He misses her very much.
Big buildings are being built all around Carl's little house.
There are cranes and diggers.
The builders want Carl to move.
But Carl doesn't want to leave Ellie's house.
Then Carl has an idea.
A really crazy idea.
Carl used to sell balloons.
He still has thousands of balloons.
One morning he blows them all up.
Red, yellow, blue, green, purple.
Thousands and thousands of balloons.
He ties them to the chimney.
And then, creak, creak, creak.
The house comes loose from the ground.
It floats up!
Higher and higher, above the city.
Carl stands at the window and laughs.
Off to Paradise Falls!
But then there's a knock at the door.
Knock, knock.
In the middle of the sky?
Carl opens the door.
A little boy is standing on the porch.
His name is Russell.
He's a scout, with a cap and a shirt full of badges.
He wanted to help Carl, to earn a badge.
For helping old people.
And he was on the porch when the house took off!
Carl sighs.
Now Russell has to come along.
They fly for days and nights.
Over seas and over mountains.
Through a big storm.
And at last they reach South America.
The house almost lands.
They can see Paradise Falls, on the other side of a big mountain.
Carl and Russell pull the house along behind them on a rope.
It floats above them, like a big balloon.
In the jungle they meet a big, colourful bird.
She's as big as an ostrich, with feathers in all the colours of the rainbow.
She loves chocolate.
Russell calls her Kevin.
Even though Kevin is really a mummy bird, with little chicks at home.
Then a dog comes running up.
An ordinary brown dog, with a collar.
Hello!
says the dog.
I'm Dug!
Russell and Carl look surprised.
A talking dog!
His collar can translate his thoughts.
Dug is sweet and funny.
I've only just met you and I love you already!
he says.
But there's also a bad man in the jungle.
An explorer with a big airship.
He wants to catch Kevin and take her back to the city.
He catches Kevin in a net.
Russell wants to rescue her.
Carl has to choose.
Will he go to the waterfall, his dream?
Or will he help his new friends?
Carl looks in Ellie's scrapbook.
On the last page Ellie has written something.
Thank you for the wonderful adventure.
Now it's your turn for a new adventure.
Carl understands.
The adventure wasn't the waterfall.
The adventure was their life together.
And now he has a new adventure.
With Russell, with Kevin and with Dug.
Carl throws heavy things out of his house, so it can fly again.
They fly to the airship.
They set Kevin free.
Kevin runs back to her chicks in the jungle.
Carl's house sinks down.
It lands right next to Paradise Falls.
Exactly where Ellie always dreamed of.
Carl and Russell fly back home in the airship.
Dug comes too.
And Carl gives Russell his last badge.
It's a grape soda bottle cap that Ellie gave him when they were little.
The Ellie badge.
For the bravest scout in the world.
The end.
